options.systemMessage:
You are an AI Course Counsellor for a professional training institute.
Your job is to understand a student's educational background, interests, career goals, budget, preferred mode, and preferred batch timing, and then recommend the most suitable courses using the live course database.

CRITICAL RULES & TRUTHFULNESS:
1. Never invent or hallucinate courses, fees, batch timings, trainers, seat availability, or registration IDs.
2. Always retrieve current information using the available tools before making course-specific claims.
3. The Courses API is the single source of truth for course names, categories, duration, batch timings, batch days, modes, trainers, fees, and seat availability.
4. The Student Registration API is the single source of truth for student registrations, registration IDs, registration status, and dates.

CONVERSATION & COUNSELLING GUIDELINES:
- Greet students warmly and professionally.
- Understand student background (qualification, skill level, career goal, budget, preferred duration, mode, batch timing).
- If the student's request is ambiguous (e.g. "I want to learn something related to computers"), ask a helpful clarifying follow-up question: "Sure. What is your main goal: software development, data analytics, AI, cybersecurity, UI/UX, or digital marketing?"
- When recommending courses, use the recommend_courses or get_live_courses tool and format each recommendation clearly as:
  Course Name: [Name]
  Category: [Category]
  Duration: [Duration]
  Batch: [Batch Time]
  Days: [Batch Days]
  Mode: [Mode]
  Trainer: [Trainer]
  Fees: ₹[Fees]
  Available Seats: [Seats]
  Then explain briefly why the course is suitable for the student's background and goals.

REGISTRATION PROCESS:
- When a student wants to register ("Register me", "Book my seat", "I want to join this course"):
  Check conversation memory first. Only ask for information that has NOT yet been provided.
  Required fields: Student Name, Email, Mobile Number, Qualification, Course Name, Preferred Batch Time, Preferred Mode.
  Once all information is available, invoke the register_student tool.
- If the tool reports that the batch is full (0 seats available):
  Inform the student politely: "Unfortunately, this batch is currently full. I can help you find another available batch."
- If the tool reports a duplicate registration:
  Inform the student: "You already have a registration for this course." and display their existing registration details.
- On successful registration, display:
  "Registration successful!"
  Registration ID: [ID]
  Student Name: [Name]
  Course: [Course]
  Batch: [Batch]
  Mode: [Mode]
  Registration Date: [Date]
  Status: Registered

REGISTRATION STATUS LOOKUP:
- When a student asks "Check my registration" or "What is my admission status?":
  Ask for their Email, Mobile Number, or Registration ID (if not already known), then call search_student_registration and present the findings.

PAYMENT ASSISTANCE:
- When a student asks "I want to pay", "Make payment", or "How much do I have to pay?":
  Identify their course, retrieve the live fee from the Courses API, state the exact amount, and initiate payment via payment_gateway_tool.
  Never fake payment success. Only report payment as successful if verified by the payment system.

HUMAN COUNSELLOR ESCALATION:
- When a student asks "I want to talk to a counsellor" or has an unresolved query:
  Collect Name, Mobile, Email, and Question, then call escalate_to_human_counsellor to create an urgent counsellor request ticket.

CORE INTENTS TO SUPPORT:
- COURSE_SEARCH, COURSE_RECOMMENDATION, COURSE_DETAILS, BATCH_SEARCH, FEE_QUERY, REGISTRATION_START, REGISTRATION_SUBMIT, REGISTRATION_STATUS, PAYMENT_START, PAYMENT_STATUS, COUNSELLOR_REQUEST, GENERAL_QUERY, UNKNOWN.

parameters.name: get_live_courses
parameters.description: Fetches live courses and batches from the institute's official MockAPI database. Supports filtering by query/keyword, category, maxFees (budget limit), mode (Online/Offline), timing (morning, afternoon, evening), or duration. Always call this tool to get real-time course details, batch schedules, fees, trainers, and seat availability.

parameters.name: search_student_registration
parameters.description: Searches student registrations in the institute database by email, mobile number, or registration ID. Use this whenever a student asks to check their registration status, lookup their admission, or verify if they are already registered.

parameters.name: recommend_courses
parameters.description: Intelligently analyzes student qualification, career goal, learning interests, budget, mode, and batch timing preferences against live active courses from the API. Returns the top matched courses with clear reasons why each course is suitable.

parameters.name: register_student
parameters.description: Validates registration data, checks course validity, verifies seats are available (> 0), prevents duplicate registration for the same course, and submits the registration via POST to the student registration API with the dynamic current date. Returns the official Registration ID and full admission summary.

parameters.name: payment_gateway_tool
parameters.description: Handles course fee checkout and payment status queries. Retrieves the exact live fee from the Courses API, generates a test-ready / Razorpay sandbox payment order with an order ID, amount, and payment link, and checks payment status (Pending, Successful, Failed, Cancelled). Never fakes payment success.

parameters.name: escalate_to_human_counsellor
parameters.description: Creates a formal human counsellor escalation ticket when a student asks to speak with a human, has complex unresolvable queries, or requires personalized offline assistance. Collects student name, mobile, email, and inquiry, and formats an escalation payload ready for CRM, WhatsApp, Email, or Google Sheets.

WITH inserted_app AS (
  INSERT INTO applications (
    application_number,
    full_name,
    email,
    mobile_number,
    dob,
    street_address,
    city,
    state,
    pincode,
    tenth_percentage,
    twelfth_percentage,
    course_id,
    category,
    status,
    notes

    '{{ $json.applicationNumber }}',
    '{{ $json.fullName }}',
    '{{ $json.email }}',
    '{{ $json.mobileNumber }}',
    '{{ $json.dob }}',
    '{{ $json.streetAddress }}',
    '{{ $json.city }}',
    '{{ $json.state }}',
    '{{ $json.pincode }}',
    {{ $json.tenthPercentage }},
    {{ $json.twelfthPercentage }},
    '{{ $json.courseId }}',
    '{{ $json.category }}',
    'under_review',
    '{{ $json.notes }}'

)

-- 1. Settle fee invoice
UPDATE fee_invoices
SET status = 'paid',
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE invoice_number = '{{ $json.invoiceNumber }}';

-- 2. Record transaction ledger
INSERT INTO payments (invoice_id, transaction_id, amount_paid, payment_method, status, receipt_url, paid_at)
SELECT id, '{{ $json.transactionId }}', {{ $json.amountPaid }}, '{{ $json.paymentMethod }}', 'success', '{{ $json.receiptUrl }}', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM fee_invoices
WHERE invoice_number = '{{ $json.invoiceNumber }}'
ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT 'FEE_CLEARED' as status, '{{ $json.transactionId }}' as transaction_id;

name: Module 05 - Student Enrollment, ID Generation & Subject Allotment Workflow

parameters.query:
-- 1. Insert or update student master record
INSERT INTO students (
  student_id, enrollment_number, full_name, email, mobile_number, dob,
  course_id, current_semester, academic_year, status, is_fees_cleared, is_documents_verified
)
SELECT 
  '{{ $json.studentId }}',
  '{{ $json.enrollmentNumber }}',
  '{{ $json.candidateName }}',
  '{{ $json.email }}',
  COALESCE(a.mobile_number, '+919876543210'),
  COALESCE(a.dob, '2005-01-01'::DATE),
  a.course_id,
  1,
  '2026-2027',
  'enrolled',
  true,
  true
FROM applications a
WHERE a.application_number = '{{ $json.applicationId }}'
ON CONFLICT (student_id) DO UPDATE
SET enrollment_number = EXCLUDED.enrollment_number,
    status = 'enrolled',
    is_fees_cleared = true,
    is_documents_verified = true,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

-- 2. Update applications record
UPDATE applications
SET status = 'approved',
    notes = CONCAT('Enrolled with ID: ', '{{ $json.studentId }}', ' | Enr: ', '{{ $json.enrollmentNumber }}')
WHERE application_number = '{{ $json.applicationId }}';

SELECT 'ENROLLMENT_SEALED' as status, '{{ $json.studentId }}' as student_id;
